description: Facts about Cursor on Target (CoT) XML that the controller's ATAK emitter (controller/atalaia_controller/atak.py) must follow, each copied from its cited public source, never from the emitter's output; read by controller/tests/test_atak.py, which checks every event the emitter makes against them (decision M9-1). The sources: [base] MITRE, 'CoT Base-Event Schema (PUBLIC RELEASE).xsd' (Version 2.0, 13-June-2003, MITRE Case #11-3895), https://github.com/deptofdefense/AndroidTacticalAssaultKit-CIV/blob/main/takcot/mitre/ ; [types] MITRE, CoTtypes.xml (v1.80 2009/06/10), https://github.com/dB-SPL/cot-types/blob/main/CoTtypes.xml ; [tak] the TAK CoT definitions, https://github.com/deptofdefense/AndroidTacticalAssaultKit-CIV/tree/main/takcot (xsd/details/, examples/) ; [proto] TAK Protocol, commoncommo/core/impl/protobuf/protocol.txt in the same repository ; [guide] Mike Butler, 'The Developer's Guide to Cursor on Target', MITRE, August 2005 ; [mesh] Meshtastic, meshtastic/atak.proto (enum Team, enum MemberRole), https://github.com/meshtastic/protobufs .

event.source: [base] element event: xs:all of point and (minOccurs 0) detail; attributes version (xs:decimal, minInclusive 2), type (pattern \w+(-\w+)*(;[^;]*)?), uid, time, start, stale (xs:dateTime) and how (pattern \w(-\w+)*), all use="required"

point.source: [base] element point: lat (xs:decimal, -90 to +90), lon (xs:decimal, -180 to +180), hae, ce, le (xs:decimal), all required; 'ce ... is intended to define a circular area around the event point, not necessarily an error (e.g. Describing a reservation area ...)'. unknown_value: [tak] examples/'Marker - Spot.cot', point hae='9999999.0' ce='9999999.0' le='9999999.0'

time.source: [base] attribute time: 'standard date format (ISO 8601): CCYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.ssZ (e.g., 2002-10-05T17:01:14.00Z), where the presence of fractional seconds (including the delimeter) is optional ... The following are all valid: 2002-10-05T18:00:23Z, 2002-10-05T18:00:23.12Z, 2002-10-05T18:00:23.123456Z'; the last one from [tak] examples/'Marker - 2525.cot' time='2020-12-16T19:59:34.910Z'
time.drop_rule: stale before start drops the marker: [guide] 'By convention, CoT allows the stale time to predate the start time. This reversal is how CoT indicates "drop track."'

b-m-p-s-m.use: a box (prop) and the extraction zone: a coloured spot marker
b-m-p-s-m.source: [tak] examples/'Marker - Spot.cot': type='b-m-p-s-m' with <color argb='-65536'/> and <usericon iconsetpath='COT_MAPPING_SPOTMAP/b-m-p-s-m/-65536'/>; [base] taxonomy 'b - Bits ... m - Mapping, p - Designated point'

a-f-G-U-C.use: a player, to staff endpoints only
a-f-G-U-C.source: [types] <cot cot="a-.-G-U-C" full="Gnd/Combat" desc="COMBAT"/>, with affiliation 'f - Friend' from [base]; [tak] examples/'Marker - 2525.cot' link type='a-f-G-U-C' (an ATAK user's own marker)

a-.-G-E-X.use: not used (ADR-P4-7's prop type; decision M9-2)

a-.-G-U-C-V.use: not used: ADR-P4-7 had it for the VIP, but it is aviation (decision M9-2)

b-m-p-s-p-i.use: not used: ADR-P4-7 had it for points of interest, but it is a sensor point of interest (decision M9-2)

affiliations.source: [base] 'CoT affiliation of these atoms: p - Pending, u - Unknown, a - Assumed friend, f - Friend, n - Neutral, s - Suspect, h - Hostile, j - Joker, k - Faker, o - None specified, x - Other'

how.h-p: human entered or modified, cut and paste from another window
how.m-g: machine generated, derived from GPS receiver
how.source: [base] attribute how: 'h - human entered or modified ... e - estimated (a swag by the user) ... p - cut and paste from another window; m - machine generated ... g - derived from GPS receiver'; [types] <how cot="m-g" nick="gps"/>, <how cot="h-e" nick="swag"/>

__group.source: [tak] xsd/details/__group.xsd: attributes name and role, use="required"

color.source: [tak] xsd/details/color.xsd: attribute argb use="required" type="xs:integer"; examples/'Marker - Spot.cot' <color argb='-65536'/> (red), examples/'Marker - 2525.cot' <color argb='-1'/> (white): ARGB as a signed 32-bit integer

usericon.source: [tak] xsd/details/usericon.xsd: attribute iconsetpath use="required"; examples/'Marker - Spot.cot' <usericon iconsetpath='COT_MAPPING_SPOTMAP/b-m-p-s-m/-65536'/>

teams.source: [mesh] enum Team labels White ... Brown (0 is 'Default (Cyan)'), enum MemberRole labels Team Member ... K9, and the comment's example <__group role='Team Member' name='Cyan'/>

transport.source: [proto] 'Traditional Protocol - "Protocol Version 0"': 'Each UDP datagram contains one (and only one) CoT XML message as its payload.' ... 'The TCP stream is comprised of one CoT <event> after another. Messages are delimited and broken apart by searching for the token "</event>" ... When sending, messages must be prefaced by XML header (<?xml ... ?>), followed by a newline, followed by the complete XML <event>. TAK servers require that no arbitrary newlines follow the </event> end of message'. The address and port: ADR-P4-7 (ATAK's defaults).

samples.name: spot marker
samples.source: [tak] examples/'Marker - Spot.cot' (deptofdefense/AndroidTacticalAssaultKit-CIV, branch main, fetched 2026-10-20): the values of the event's attributes, its point and the details the emitter also writes, copied one by one; the files' other details (status readiness, archive, link, precisionlocation) are left out, and the file itself is not copied (decision M9-1)
